Delhi civic body seals properties after building collapses

Following fatal building collapses, Delhi's civic body has intensified its crackdown, sealing 282 properties and demolishing 47 dangerous structures. The action was taken against a total of 1,046 properties in the Satya Niketan area after a recent building collapse.
